name: Yoga school in Amsterdam
reason: No usable school found in three searches. Results were mostly directories (BookRetreats, Yoga Alliance, Urban Sports Club, OneFit). B.K.S. Iyengar Yoga Institute Amsterdam: iyengaryogaamsterdam.com now redirects to an online-only class site (iyengaryogaonline.com) whose classes are 'postponed' since 2022. Yogaschool Amsterdam (Iyengar, Kanaalstraat; teacher training led by Kristien Van Reusel since 1999), found via its Momoyoga booking pages: its own site yogaschoolamsterdam.nl answered our robots.txt request with HTTP 403, so it was not fetched (blocked means skip). Evolation Yoga (hot yoga) is out of scope.
